cmd.convert_v5.help.long:
Convert a v5-style VEAF mission folder to v6 format.

Runs all migration steps in a single pass:
 
1. Scans the mission folder for v5 artifacts (missionConfig.lua, pipeline config files such as presets.yaml, waypoints.yaml, …).
2. Migrates missionConfig.lua in-place: comments out doFile() calls that load VEAF scripts (the v6 builder injects them automatically), and wraps bare veafXxx.initialize() calls in ``if veafXxx then … end`` guards.
3. Generates mission.yaml with the correct lua_modules: and pipeline: sections derived from the analysis in steps 1 and 2.
4. Prints a detailed conversion report and optionally saves it as Markdown.

DCS trigger conversion (v5 → v6) is handled automatically by ``veaf-tools build`` — no manual action is required for that part.
cmd.convert_v5.opt.folder: Path to the VEAF mission folder to convert (where mission.yaml should be created).
cmd.convert_v5.opt.no_backup: Do not create a .bak copy of missionConfig.lua before migrating it.
cmd.convert_v5.opt.no_pipeline: Skip automatic conversion of v5 pipeline config files (presets, waypoints, weather, aircraft groups). Files will be listed as needing manual conversion instead.
cmd.convert_v5.opt.report_file: Save the conversion report to a Markdown file. Defaults to <mission_folder>/convert-v5-report.md.
cmd.convert_v5.opt.icao: ICAO airport code to use for realweather pipeline steps (e.g. UGGG). Skips the interactive prompt.

generated.mission_yaml.header:
mission.yaml — VEAF mission configuration
Generated by: veaf-tools generate-config

Place this file at the root of your mission folder.
All sections are optional — remove or comment out what you don't need.
See: https://github.com/VEAF/VEAF-Mission-Creation-Tools/blob/master/doc/MISSION_MAKER_GUIDE.md
generated.mission_yaml.section.global_lo:
── Global log level ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Forces all VEAF loggers to this level. Remove or set to 'info' for players.
Values: error | warning | info | debug | trace
generated.mission_yaml.section.settings:
── Generic settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Arbitrary veaf.config.XXX = value assignments.
generated.mission_yaml.section.modules:
── Module configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Enable/disable individual VEAF Lua modules and override their log level.
Modules not listed here default to enabled.

generated.mission_yaml.section.qra:
── QRA (Quick Reaction Alert) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

generated.mission_yaml.section.cap:
── CAP missions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Requires COMBATMISSION module enabled above.
generated.mission_yaml.section.combat:
── Combat missions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Requires COMBATMISSION module enabled above.
generated.mission_yaml.section.pipeline:
── Build pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Controls which optional injection steps run after the base build.
Each step auto-detects its config file; set to false to skip.

updater.cmd_help:
Downloads the latest VEAF Tools files from GitHub using Git tags.

This command fetches compiled tools and scripts from GitHub releases.
By default, it uses the 'published-latest' tag which always points to the most recent version.

For testing, use --zip-file to install from a local published.zip file instead of GitHub.
